messages.O lecție interactivă despre cum descriem: An interactive lesson on describing motion along a curved path: position, velocity and acceleration, with animations, simulations and formulas explained step by step.
messages.Teorie — cum descriem mișcarea pe curbă: Theory — describing motion along a curve
messages.Până acum ai studiat mișcarea rectilinie: You have already studied rectilinear motion: a particle moves along a straight line. In reality, most motion follows curved paths. Here we introduce how to describe them.

messages.Distanța totală parcursă, împărțită la d: The total distance travelled divided by the total time. It includes the entire path, including any sections travelled after reversing direction. It has no direction or orientation.

messages.La un moment dat, viteza scalară instant: At a given instant, speed is the magnitude of instantaneous velocity. Over a finite interval, the average of the speed and the magnitude of average velocity generally differ. Average speed is also generally different from the arithmetic mean of the initial and final speeds.

messages.Pornim de la o curbă plană oarecare. Vec: Start with a general plane curve. The velocity vector is tangent to the curve and points in the direction of motion. Compare it with a circle and an ellipse, or design a custom curve. The shape of a trajectory alone does not determine speed.

messages.O mașină merge cu 60 km/h constant pe un: A car travels at a constant 60 km/h along a winding road. Does it have acceleration?
messages.Modulul vitezei e constant (aₜ = 0), dar: Its speed is constant (aₜ = 0), but its direction changes in bends, so there is normal acceleration aₙ = v²/R, pointing towards the inside of the curve.
messages.Ce se întâmplă cu aₙ dacă viteza se dubl: What happens to aₙ if speed doubles on the same curve?
: aₙ = v²/R depends on speed squared. At the same radius of curvature, doubling speed makes normal acceleration four times as large.
messages.În ce caz accelerația totală este doar t: When is total acceleration purely tangential?
messages.Când componenta normală este nulă și mod: When the normal component is zero and speed changes. This occurs in nonuniform rectilinear motion and can occur at a point of zero curvature on a curved path.
